texts.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上的准备工作已经完毕；我们的特工已经准备好将[target.GetName]引入只有一步之遥的星海的大舞台。

texts.zh:
得益于我们特工的杰出工作，[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经开始如痴如醉地仰望星空。

我们间谍网特工的大胆举措帮助[this.capital_scope.GetName]的居民理解了自己在宇宙中并不孤单这件事。现在他们已经做好了接受联络的准备，而不至于对他们的生活方式造成冲击。
texts.en:
Thanks to the skilled work of our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking to the skies with an insatiable fascination.

The bold efforts of our Spy Network operatives have helped the inhabitants of [this.capital_scope.GetName] to understand they are not alone in the universe. They are now ready, and willing to be contacted without risk of interstellar culture shock.

texts.zh:
得益于我们特工的杰出工作，[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经开始如痴如醉地仰望星空。

许多人已经确信自己在宇宙中并不孤单。他们知道证据近在咫尺，假以时日一定能够找到。
texts.en:
Thanks to the skilled work of our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking to the skies with an insatiable fascination.

 Many are now certain they are not alone in the universe. They know the proof is within reach, and finding it is just a matter of time.

texts.zh:
得益于我们特工的杰出工作，[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经开始如痴如醉地仰望星空。

他们激动地分享着关于天空中神秘光亮和繁星之外世界的来客们的故事。许多人相信这些故事应该不是空穴来风。
texts.en:
Thanks to the skilled work of our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking to the skies with an insatiable fascination.

They excitedly share stories of mysterious lights in the sky and visitors from worlds beyond the stars. Many rightfully believe the stories to be the truth.

texts.zh:
得益于我们特工的杰出工作，[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经开始如痴如醉地仰望星空。

在我们特工散布的故事的激励和启发下，[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在将他们的关注点转向天空。他们正积极地畅想宇宙中其他感性生命的存在。
texts.en:
Thanks to the skilled work of our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking to the skies with an insatiable fascination.

Inspired and delighted by the stories spread by our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their gaze to the sky. They are openly speculating on the existence of other sentient life in the universe.

The efforts of our Spy Network operatives have led the inhabitants of [this.capital_scope.GetName] to understand they are not alone in the universe. They may now be contacted without risk of extreme shock.

texts.zh:
我们特工的行动让[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始惧怕夜空。

许多人现在相信自己在宇宙中并不孤独。他们知道真相就在外面，但对此毫无兴趣。
texts.en:
The actions of our operatives have caused the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to fear the night sky.

Many are now concerned they are not alone in the universe. They believe the truth is out there, but they have little interest in finding it.

texts.zh:
我们特工的行动让[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始惧怕夜空。

他们闪烁其词地互相诉说着天空中诡异光亮和来自外星世界的入侵者的恐怖故事。
texts.en:
The actions of our operatives have caused the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to fear the night sky.

They share spooky stories in hushed tones of mysterious lights in the sky and invaders from worlds beyond the stars.

texts.zh:
我们特工的行动让[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始惧怕夜空。

[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被我们特工所散布的故事吓住了，现在连抬头看一眼都胆战心惊。他们开始怀疑在宇宙中是否有其他的感性生命，在黑暗中虎视眈眈。
texts.en:
The actions of our operatives have caused the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to fear the night sky.

Frightened by the stories spread by our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking upwards with great trepidation. They have begun to ask themselves if there may be other sentient life in the universe, lurking in the darkness.

texts.en: Thanks to the actions of our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking at the night sky with renewed interest. They whisper stories few believe, of mysterious lights in the sky and visitors from worlds beyond the stars... Stories with a grain of truth.

texts.en: Inspired by the stories we spread, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their gaze to the sky. They have begun to ask themselves if there might be other sentient life in the universe, bathing in the light of other stars.

# 间谍网络：准备现身 / Spy Network: Ready to Reveal
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 间谍行动结局（前FTL）pre-FTL espionage operation finale

## 如何开始 How it starts

玩家对前FTL文明发动“提高觉醒度”行动（`operation_increase_awareness`，`pre_ftl_operations.txt:17-156`），完成最后一章后触发本事件。行动章节：每个针对前FTL文明的间谍行动由 3–4 个章节组成，前几章触发隐藏占位事件 preftl_operation.100，最后一章触发本事件。章节检定失败时（pre_ftl_espionage_operation_on_roll_failed，`espionage_event_effects.txt:2840–2906`），有 10/400 的概率（无“外貌改造”科技时 ×1.5；同一行动 120 天内最多一次）从随机事件池抽取插曲（3000–3105）；插曲的选项会改变行动的成功度变量 pre_ftl_operation_success（±1/±2），最终事件按该变量选择结果档：>2 极佳，>0 良好，=0 标准，<0 糟糕（`first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:3093–3130`）。 / The player runs the “Increase Awareness” operation (operation_increase_awareness) against a pre-FTL country; completing its last chapter fires this event. Operation chapters: each espionage operation against a pre-FTL country has 3–4 chapters; the early ones fire the hidden placeholder preftl_operation.100 and the last one fires this event. When a chapter roll fails there is a 10-in-400 chance (×1.5 without the appearance-modding tech; at most once per 120 days per operation) to draw an interlude (3000–3105); interlude options change the success variable pre_ftl_operation_success (±1 / ±2). The finale then picks an outcome tier: >2 great, >0 good, =0 standard, <0 poor.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**准备揭示（1025）**→ 按成功度选择：**1027 外面有生命**（极佳/良好）、**1026 外面有生命吗？**（标准）、**1028 外面什么也没有**（糟糕）。1026 / 1028 之后会进入 action.2 的首次接触窗口（觉醒度已满时的文本不同），随后 progress.4/5/6 记录对方文明接触。 / Ready to Reveal (1025) → by tier: 1027 (great/good), 1026 (standard), 1028 (poor); 1026 and 1028 lead to the first-contact window action.2 and then progress.4/5/6.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

极佳/良好/标准/糟糕四档互斥：1027（>2）、1027（>0）、1026（=0）、1028（<0）。/ Four exclusive tiers: great 1027, good 1027, standard 1026, poor 1028.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

结局文本因观察者类型（普通/蜂巢/机械）、目标是否前工业时代而异。/ Text varies with the owner type and the target’s era.
